logp.method_description: The lipophilicity of each complex was determined via a standard shake-flask method, and is expressed as a log (Po/w) value where Po/w represents the octanol/water partitioning coefficient. To determine the log (Po/w) value of each complex, complexes were dissolved into 1000 μL of ultra-purified water saturated octanol, followed by the addition of 1000 μL of ultra-purified water saturated with octanol. The layers were thoroughly agitated by vortexing for 30 s. The mixtures were placed into a 37 °C incubator with shaking for 24 h before the layers were separated, and the interface discarded. These were then aliquoted into 2–3 % nitric acid with the indium content in each analysed via ICP-OES or ICP-MS. These values were then taken and used to calculate the log (Po/w). All log (Po/w) analyses were performed in triplicate.
